text: Because of the last step of the negative branch. After `-` is stripped, `"0"` passes the digit and leading-zero checks and parses to 0; then `magnitude.checked_neg().filter(|v| *v < 0)` requires the negated value to be strictly below zero, and -0 is 0, so the filter turns it into `None`. `"-12"` passes the filter and `"0"` never takes the negative branch. Dropping the `.filter(...)` would make `-0` parse as 0, if that's what you want.
